notes: Standard list prices. Launch promos (e.g. the GLM-5.3-Flash 50%-off window) and flat-rate coding-plan subscriptions are NOT reflected: turns served under a coding plan are paid by quota, so the baseline's USD figures are the list-price EQUIVALENT of the token volume, not the actual cash out.
cached_input is the cache READ (hit) rate. Z.AI cache-write storage is limited-time free; cache-write tokens are stored in turn_usage.cached_write_tokens but not billed in v1.
Unknown model ids resolve to no rate and are FLAGGED in the baseline report — numbers are never invented.
